title: Force Deployment Planning and Execution (FDP&E) Officer (I) (LtCol to Maj) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
1. MOS 0502, Force Deployment Planning and Execution (FDP&E) Officer (I)
(LtCol to Maj) FMOS, DC PP&O

    a. Summary. FDP&E officers are responsible for developing force
deployment plans and providing oversight during the deployment of units,
personnel, equipment, and supplies. FDP&E officers provide a critical
linkage between capabilities, combatant commanders, and MARFORs during
planning and force deployment execution processes and ensure the commander’s
force deployment plan is executable and adheres to time phased force
deployment data (TPFDD) guidance. FDP&E officers serve as staff leads on
deployment operations teams. Responsibilities of these positions include
ensuring accurate deployment planning during the MCPP and providing oversight
during force deployment execution. FDP&E officers are assigned to HQMC,
MEFs, and MARFOR level headquarters and within any deploying MAGTF staff
above the MEB level.

    b. Prerequisites. Security requirement: top secret security clearance
eligibility and be eligible for access to SCI.

       c.   Requirements

            (1) Complete the following requirements in order:

                (a)   Global Force Management Overview (JKO), virtual.

                (b) Serve no less than three months in an FDP&E officer billet.

            (c) JOPES Action Officer Course (JD2101), Joint Deployment
Training Center (JOTC), Ft Eustis, VA or JDTC Virtual Campus-Online or MTT.

            (d) Joint Capabilities Requirements Manager Course (GF1102),
Joint Deployment Training Center, Ft Eustis, VA or JDTC Virtual Campus-Online
or MTT.

        (2) FMOS 0502 will be awarded after completion of all courses and a
minimum of six months experience in an FDP&E officer billet.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (ch) Marine Corps Force Deployment Planning and Execution Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Command and Control Center Officers 55-1015.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
